text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I burned,
and burned out completely...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Every muscle in my body is swollen and exhausted...
I don't have a single drop of strength left...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, hehehehe...
Yes, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I did it…… Everything I've done up till now
wasn't for nothing……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
To think I could run in the Classic of my dreams like this...
And my number is even on the board...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... I'm truly so glad...
To be honest, I'd almost be fine if everything ended right here..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: This is just... the beginning!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Ines!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um, well... Good work today!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan-chan, it's all about next time, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Because next up is the Classic of Classics,
the Japanese Derby♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Running this well means you can
enter the Derby too, right? Congratulations!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Saying congratulations, huh... I see.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Why would I run in the Derby...?
To be honest, I hadn't thought that far ahead.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I figured as much. But we can just start thinking about it now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's—where Ryan-chan and I will be doing it for real.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Bye! I'm gonna head back to my room first.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, just so you know, once we get back to the room,
no competing with each other, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The Derby...
It's the Derby, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's fire ourselves up and get to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Could you let me stay like this for just a little longer?
It feels so nice...
A refreshing spring breeze gently caressed Mejiro Ryan's heated body.

And so, the first leg of the Classics,
the Satsuki Sho, was over.
